source_title: FBI says North Korea behind $6 billion Binance crypto theft
source_excerpt:
The FBI said Saturday that North Korea was behind the theft of more than $6 billion (€5.36 billion) in virtual assets from the cryptocurrency exchange Binance.
"The Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea) was responsible for the theft of more than $6 billion USD in virtual assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance, on or about October 29, 2026," the US law enforcement agency said in a statement.
The theft, which happened within a matter of minutes, is believed to be the biggest cryptocurrency heist in history.
The stolen assets included bitcoin, ethereum and stablecoins such as tether and USD Coin, whose values are pegged to traditional currencies.
News of the cyberattack caused the prices of most major cryptocurrencies to slump on Friday.
On Sunday, Binance resumed withdrawals, saying the process would be completed in phases, with the first covering 15 cryptocurrencies, including bitcoin, ether, XRP and dogecoin.
The company had suspended withdrawals after the hack.

The FBI said the theft was tied to "malicious cyber activity" by an entity known as TraderTraitor, the same actors behind a $1.5 billion Bybit hack last year.
The agency said it had "observed TraderTraitor actors converting stolen assets" primarily into a cryptocurrency called ethereum.
"It is expected these assets will then be further laundered by converting them using DeFi [decentralized finance] and instant swap services as they prepare them for further laundering stages," it added.
The FBI asked crypto exchanges, blockchain analytics companies and others to block transactions linked to various addresses to ensure the money is not laundered to cover up its origins.

Binance is the world's largest crypto exchange by daily trading volumes.
The exchange said on Saturday it was using company funds worth over $6.34 billion to buy tokens to replenish about 90% of the assets stolen in the attack.
The remaining 10% consisted of tokens that were less liquid, meaning they may take longer to buy back, the company said.
"Our commitment remains the same: Binance will fully cover the financial impact of the funds stolen in this incident," the company said on X.
The heist came amid growing worries that the ever-expanding capabilities of artificial intelligence models could compromise cryptography and IT security protocols.

## अमेरिका की संघीय एजेंसी का बयान
अमेरिकी कानून प्रवर्तन एजेंसी एफबीआई (FBI) ने शनिवार को एक बयान जारी कर दावा किया है कि क्रिप्टोकरेंसी एक्सचेंज 'बिनेंस' (Binance) से 6 अरब अमेरिकी डॉलर से अधिक के वर्चुअल एसेट्स की चोरी के पीछे उत्तर कोरिया का हाथ था। एजेंसी के अनुसार, यह घटना लगभग 29 अक्टूबर 2026 को हुई थी और इसे इतिहास की सबसे बड़ी क्रिप्टोकरेंसी चोरी माना जा रहा है।

चोरी की गई परिसंपत्तियों (assets) में बिटकॉइन, एथेरियम और स्टेबलकॉइन्स जैसे टेथर (Tether) और यूएसडी कॉइन शामिल हैं। इस साइबर हमले के बाद शुक्रवार को प्रमुख क्रिप्टोकरेंसी की कीमतों में गिरावट दर्ज की गई थी।

## 'ट्रेडरट्रेटर' समूह पर संदेह
एफबीआई ने अपने बयान में कहा है कि यह चोरी 'ट्रेडरट्रेटर' (TraderTraitor) नामक समूह की दुर्भावनापूर्ण साइबर गतिविधियों से जुड़ी है। इसी समूह पर पिछले साल 'बाइबीआईट' (Bybit) पर हुए 1.5 अरब डॉलर के हमले का भी संदेह है।
* एजेंसी ने बताया कि उसने 'ट्रेडरट्रेटर' से जुड़े तत्वों को चुराए गए एसेट्स को मुख्य रूप से एथेरियम में बदलते हुए देखा है।
* आशंका जताई जा रही है कि इन फंड्स को डीएफआई (DeFi) और इंस्टेंट स्वैप सेवाओं के जरिए आगे और खपाया (laundered) जाएगा।

एफबीआई ने क्रिप्टोकरेंसी एक्सचेंजों और ब्लॉकचेन एनालिटिक्स कंपनियों से अपील की है कि वे इन संदिग्ध पतों से जुड़े लेन-देन को ब्लॉक करें ताकि चोरी की गई रकम को छुपाने से रोका जा सके।

## बिनेंस की प्रतिक्रिया और निकासी की बहाली
दुनिया के सबसे बड़े क्रिप्टो एक्सचेंज बिनेंस ने इस घटना के बाद निकासी (withdrawals) को अस्थायी रूप से निलंबित कर दिया था। रविवार को कंपनी ने घोषणा की कि निकासी प्रक्रिया चरणों में फिर से शुरू कर दी गई है, जिसकी शुरुआत पहले चरण में बिटकॉइन, एथर, एक्सआरपी और डॉगकॉइन सहित 15 क्रिप्टोकरेंसी के साथ हुई है।

बिनेंस ने शनिवार को कहा कि वह चोरी हुए फंड का लगभग 90 प्रतिशत हिस्सा वापस पाने के लिए 6.34 अरब डॉलर से अधिक के अपने फंड का उपयोग करके टोकन खरीद रहा है। शेष 10 प्रतिशत टोकन कम तरल (less liquid) हैं, जिन्हें वापस खरीदने में अधिक समय लग सकता है। कंपनी ने सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म 'एक्स' पर स्पष्ट किया कि वह इस घटना में वित्तीय नुकसान की पूरी भरपाई करने के लिए प्रतिबद्ध है।

## आगे की स्थिति और सत्यापन
इस मामले में अभी स्वतंत्र स्रोतों या उत्तर कोरियाई पक्ष से कोई पुष्टि नहीं मिल पाई है। इस तरह की अंतरराष्ट्रीय साइबर सुरक्षा घटनाओं और आधिकारिक घोषणाओं की सत्यता की जांच के लिए संबंधित कानून प्रवर्तन एजेंसियों और संबंधित एक्सचेंज के आधिकारिक प्रेस विज्ञप्ति पृष्ठों की नियमित समीक्षा की जानी चाहिए।

en_body:
## Investigation Points to North Korean Cyber Activity

The United States Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) announced on Saturday that North Korea was responsible for the theft of more than $6 billion in virtual assets from the cryptocurrency exchange Binance. According to the law enforcement agency's statement, the incident occurred on or about October 29, 2026, and is widely reported to be the largest cryptocurrency heist in history.

The stolen funds comprised various digital assets, including bitcoin, ethereum, and stablecoins such as tether and USD Coin. The cyberattack prompted a market reaction, causing prices of major cryptocurrencies to decline on Friday.

## Attribution and Laundering Concerns

The FBI stated that the breach was linked to malicious cyber activity conducted by an entity known as TraderTraitor—the same actor group previously associated with a $1.5 billion hack targeting the Bybit exchange in the prior year.

Investigators reported observing TraderTraitor actors converting the stolen funds primarily into ethereum. The FBI warned that these assets are expected to undergo further laundering stages using decentralized finance (DeFi) and instant swap services. In response, the agency has urged cryptocurrency exchanges and blockchain analytics firms to block transactions tied to specific addresses associated with the incident.

## Binance Response and Platform Recovery

Binance, recognized as the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by daily trading volumes, temporarily suspended withdrawals following the security breach. 

* **Asset Replenishment:** On Saturday, Binance announced plans to utilize over $6.34 billion in company funds to purchase replacement tokens.
* **Coverage Scope:** The exchange stated this action would cover approximately 90% of the stolen assets, while less liquid tokens representing the remaining 10% would take longer to repurchase.
* **Withdrawal Resumption:** By Sunday, Binance began phasing the resumption of withdrawals, starting with an initial group of 15 cryptocurrencies, including bitcoin, ether, XRP, and dogecoin.

Public statements regarding the financial coverage were shared by the company on the social media platform X, where representatives reiterated that the platform intends to fully absorb the financial impact of the incident.

## Verification and Practical Implications

Independent verification of the claims made by law enforcement and the exchange can be conducted by reviewing official statements published on the FBI's newsroom portal and Binance's official corporate channels and verified social media accounts. Stakeholders and users are advised to monitor blockchain analytics reports and exchange announcements for updates regarding address blacklists and withdrawal statuses.
en_title: FBI Attributes Record $6 Billion Cryptocurrency Heist to North Korean Actors
